mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdl (tdl_num, group_num, member_num, tdl_name, tdl_detail, status, repeat_type, created_at, due_at) VALUES (tdl_seq.nextVal, #{group_num}, #{member_num}, #{tdl_name}, #{tdl_detail}, #{status}, #{repeat_type, jdbcType=DATE}, SYSDATE, #{due_at, jdbcType=DATE})
mapper.select: SELECT t.tdl_num, m.member_nick, t.tdl_name, t.tdl_detail, t.status, t.repeat_type, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.completed_at, t.due_at, FN_GROUP_RESOURCE_PERMISSION(t.group_num, t.member_num, #{member_num}) AS can_manage FROM tdl t JOIN member m ON t.member_num = m.member_num WHERE group_num = #{group_num}
mapper.update: UPDATE tdl SET tdl_name = #{tdl_name}, tdl_detail = #{tdl_detail}, repeat_type = #{repeat_type}, updated_at = SYSDATE
UPDATE tdl SET status = #{status}, updated_at = SYSDATE, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'Done' THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END WHERE tdl_num = #{tdl_num} AND status != 'Incomplete'
